E3 shows (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 nanoflakes have tribocatalytic activity, but this is a sulfide, not a metallic alloying addition, so the tribocatalysis premise is weakly supported. No evidence supports solid solution strengthening of TC4 by MoWNbTaV or that properties are preserved.
